mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5% for 10 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0%, it signals a weak labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE exceeds 8.0% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline for 2 consecutive months but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing supply shock (INDPRO growth rate below 0.5% for 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to inflationary pressures and reduced corporate margins.
failure_condition: INDPRO 3-month growth rate remains below 0.5% for 6 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains below its 12-month moving average for 6 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 900,000 units, it signals a contraction in the housing market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST remains below 900.0 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a rise in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% indicates a monetary policy response to inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to increased uncertainty.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL rises above 2.5% for 2 consecutive months but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods.
